description: Paid (x402: USDC on Base, USDC on Solana, XRP on XRPL, USDC on Arc, or XAH on Xahau). Fit isotonic calibration on YOUR labelled outcomes ({p,y} pairs) and recalibrate the given probabilities. Stateless; nothing is stored.

examples.description: Your labelled outcomes used to fit the isotonic calibration: objects with p (the probability you predicted, 0-1) and y (the realised outcome, 0 or 1).

p.description: Predicted probability for this example, between 0 and 1.

y.description: Realised outcome for this example: 1 if the event happened, 0 if it did not.

probs.description: Probabilities to recalibrate with the fitted mapping, each between 0 and 1.

name: court_calibrate_labels
title: Calibrate Probabilities on Your Labelled Outcomes
